concerns.text: The task states “exactly 500 trajectories (balanced low/medium/high density)”. 500 is not divisible by three, so “balanced” is ambiguous. The deliverable must specify the exact per‑density counts (e.g., 167 low, 166 medium, 167 high) or relax the total count requirement.

Task T022 only says “Verify hypothesis‑summary output” but does not name a script, test file, or concrete verification method. The task lacks a concrete deliverable and a verifiable pass/fail criterion.

Task T039 describes an end‑to‑end smoke test but does not specify how the test is automated or verified (no test script, no assertion of artifact existence). A concrete test artifact (e.g., a pytest script) and its success condition are needed.
